messages.content: Here is your fully animated lesson for **Newton's First Law — Chapter 9**!

learning_objectives: Understand the fundamental principles of Newton's First Law
Apply core formulas of Newton's First Law to solve basic problems
Explore real-world analogies regarding Newton's First Law
explanation_package.core_explanation: Newton's First Law represents a key physical phenomenon where system interactions establish thermodynamic, mechanical, or chemical equilibriums. To grasp this, let's look at the basic equations that define it...
analogies: Think of Newton's First Law like a tug-of-war where both sides pull with equal strength, maintaining absolute stillness while experiencing high tension.
It is like two escalator tracks moving at identical speeds in opposite directions, keeping a walking person perfectly in place.
visual_elements: Glow animations for peak stress points

scene_plan.title: Mathematical Breakdown
scene_plan.description: Derives key state equations step-by-step using highlighted equations zooming into focus.

scene_plan.title: Analogy Demonstration
scene_plan.description: Visualizes a dynamic model of a balance scale adjusting in real-time, showing visual equilibrium.
